headline: Security fixes led the week, and new defaults in Codex, Kilo Code and Claude Code changed what runs out of the box.

themes.title: Permission and sandbox holes closed
themes.facts: Claude Code 2.1.328 closes an MCP header leak on redirect and a sandbox network-rule bypass ([v2.1.328](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.328)). Antigravity CLI 1.5.14 fixed a Windows credential leak through UNC paths, and 1.5.17 closes a bypass of approval and deny rules on sensitive files in Gemini Enterprise sessions ([1.5.14](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.14), [1.5.17](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.17)). Kilo Code v7.8.32 carries the hono and node-forge security updates ([v7.8.32](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/releases/tag/v7.8.32)).
themes.so_what: update Claude Code to 2.1.328 or later, Antigravity CLI to 1.5.17 or later and Kilo Code to 7.8.32 or later.

themes.title: New defaults change models, effort and updates
themes.facts: Codex CLI [rust-v0.171.0](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.171.0) made GPT-6.2 Sol the default model, and Antigravity CLI [1.5.15](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.15) defaults Orchestrator effort to high when unset. Claude Code [2.1.331](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.331) auto-updates managed plugin marketplaces from November 30 unless you set `autoUpdate` to false.
themes.so_what: pin the model, effort and marketplace settings you rely on before the defaults apply to your jobs.

themes.title: Auto mode runs more steps without asking
themes.facts: Claude Code [2.1.328](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.328) added auto mode for Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 on more cloud providers, and [2.1.332](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.332) starts sessions in auto mode on some clouds. Antigravity CLI [1.5.14](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.14) stopped asking before reads outside the workspace, and [1.5.16](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.16) asks less often before edits inside Git, Jujutsu or Mercurial repositories.
themes.so_what: fewer prompts also means fewer checkpoints, so keep your ask and deny rules current.

watch_next: Claude Code's marketplace auto-update starts on November 30, so review managed marketplace settings before then. Also watch whether the new Codex default model changes results in your sessions.
